title: Filing: OpenAI says a staffer who joined Apple sent 100+ files to a personal account and made a presentation about an unreleased product to Apple leadership (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Filing: OpenAI says a staffer who joined Apple sent 100+ files to a personal account and made a presentation about an unreleased product to Apple leadership — An OpenAI employee who left the ChatGPT maker for Apple (AAPL.O) sent more than 100 files about an unreleased product to a personal account …
